items.question: When in the year should we start?
items.answer: Audits and backup plans work best between May and July, before close-out. New platforms are ideally implemented to launch in August. A 30-minute call sets the calendar with no commitment.

items.question: How do you handle student and family data?
items.answer: With the LFPDPPP as the baseline: data inventory, privacy notice, minimal access and encrypted backups. Records never leave systems the school controls.

items.question: Will school staff be able to run it alone?
items.answer: Yes. Every delivery includes staff training and documentation; the goal is a school that publishes and operates without depending on an outside developer.

items.question: Do you work with small schools?
items.answer: Yes. Many outcomes start with a software audit or a checklist from the store, with no large project involved.

audit.title: Score your school's technology in 5 minutes
audit.body: A questionnaire with a school lens: website, security, cloud and digital workflows. You get a score and the three fixes with the biggest payoff.

final.title: Let's talk about the coming year
final.body: A free 30-minute call. You leave with a clear calendar and an honest recommendation, even if that is to start with a checklist.
